description: Reader view of one public https page: its <title> and the <main> or <article> content (else <body>) as Markdown, with links and images resolved. Removes scripts, styles, navigation, footers, forms and iframes. Cookie banners built as plain divs are NOT removed. Pages that block automated requests return a 503. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

url.description: Public https:// (or http://) page address, up to 2048 characters
